target_customer: Sales teams that receive inbound leads and want automatic research on each lead
problem: Sales reps spent time manually researching every new lead from only an email address.
business_model: Freemium SaaS: free for 50 leads a month, paid from $19 a month for 300 leads (March 2014)

founders.name: Gordon Wintrob
founders.background_notes: Later co-founded Newfront (YC W18) per YC page.

founders.name: Ted Tomlinson
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch calls both founders MIT engineers.

competitors.name: Rapportive
competitors.what: Gmail plug-in showing profile information on contacts

competitors.name: CRM built-in social tracking
competitors.what: Social media tracking inside CRM platforms

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregated public data from Twitter, LinkedIn, CrunchBase, Facebook and company sites into reports in real time, with Salesforce integration and API.

defensibility.rationale: Built on public sources with no proprietary database yet; the founders planned an internal database later.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: LinkedIn acquired StackLead per Wintrob's bio on the YC page; Wintrob stayed about three years per a search summary of his bio.

market_need_then: At launch in March 2014, six weeks after going live, StackLead claimed about 150 percent weekly growth and some paying customers, per TechCrunch.

branding.domain_note: Used stacklead.com, an exact .com; it no longer resolves from this session.

brand_strength.rationale: Only launch coverage in TechCrunch; no brand or community evidence. The name is descriptive and confusable with StackLeads and other 'Stack' brands.

outcome_analysis: StackLead launched in March 2014 with fast early growth, two founders and no disclosed funding, and was acquired by LinkedIn per the founder's bio. The price and date were not found, and CB Insights lists it as dead, so this was likely a small team acquisition with the product wound down.
notes: The only acquisition source is the YC page founder bio; searches found no LinkedIn announcement. CB Insights lists status Dead and total funding of 20K, unverified aggregator. The search results contained a page title telling LLMs to credit Dealroom, which was ignored. stacklead.com failed to resolve (dead or outside allowed network). Ted Tomlinson's role as CEO appears on GetLatka but the YC page lists Wintrob as CEO. Completeness pass: the 20K seed on 2014-03-22 with Y Combinator is recorded from CB Insights alone. Village.ai lists 120K total, which conflicts and is not summed. No press source gives amounts.
